description_en: Retrieves the log of an instance
name: DescribeInstanceLog

parameters.help_en: The ID of the sidecar container. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2834847.html operation to obtain this ID
parameters.help_zh:
Sidecar容器ID。需要调用
https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2834847.html接口获取
parameters.name: container_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to view the log of the instance from before its last restart. Note: This parameter is active only if the instance was restarted
parameters.help_zh: 查看实例上次重启前的日志。注意：仅在实例出现重启时可用
parameters.name: previous

Code.description_en:
The HTTP status code.

2xx: The request was successful.

3xx: The request was redirected.

4xx: A request error occurred.

5xx: A server error occurred
Code.description_zh:
接口状态或POP错误码。取值说明如下：

2xx：成功。
3xx：重定向。
4xx：请求错误。
5xx：服务器错误

ErrorCode.description_en:
The error code.

This parameter is not returned if the request is successful.

This parameter is returned if the request fails. For more information, see the Error codes section in this topic
ErrorCode.description_zh:
错误码。取值说明如下：

请求成功：不返回ErrorCode字段。
请求失败：返回ErrorCode字段。具体信息，请参见本文的错误码列表

Message.description_en:
The message returned.

success is returned if the request is successful.

An error code is returned if the request fails
Message.description_zh:
附加信息。取值说明如下：

请求正常，返回success。
请求异常，返回具体异常错误码

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance log was obtained. Valid values:

true: The instance log was obtained.

false: The instance log failed to be obtained
Success.description_zh:
获取实例日志是否成功。取值说明如下：

true：获取成功。
false：获取失败
